record.question: If R is ranked second and Q is ranked fifth, which of these must be true?
record.explanation: With R second, S must be first. Q is fifth; V and P must occupy third and fourth in that order. The last two places are T and U, and U must be last because Q is not last. Hence T is sixth. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026.

record.passage:
I. Seven boys P, Q, R, S, T, U and V take a series of tests.
II. V always scores more than P.
III. P always scores more than Q.
IV. No two boys get similar marks.
V. Each time either R scores the highest and T gets the least, or alternatively S scores the highest and U or Q scores the least.
